address: Hoofdbureau van Politie, Elandsgracht 117, Amsterdam (Jordaan, corner of Marnixstraat)
notes: walls[0] (3DBAG panels 80, 26, 9): the long north-west wall on the street (panorama 2025-06-30, 2016-08-17) is dark brick with white steel-window ribbons, about 14 bays on three storeys under a recessed white top ribbon; ground floor has a glazed ribbon on the right and a gated vehicle entrance on the left (not modelled). The courtyard-side walls of the same wing (panel 26) are assumed the same (inferred).

walls[2] (panel 3, surface 4): the south-west wall on the Singelgracht (panorama 2021-01-25) is NOT brick: pinkish stone cladding with square yellow-framed windows in three rows of ~11, a yellow-framed top ribbon, a large yellow-framed glazed bay at ground and a stone sculpture group on a bracket at the left. Modelled as a bay grid with a stone-pink wall and yellow frames; the sculpture and the glazed bay are not modelled.

walls[8], [10], [11] (panels 48, 7, 13: the 157 deg south-east fronts): 1941 brick with sash windows and heavy white stone hoods and sills, brick chequer bands between the window rows (panorama 2025-07-03, 2021-09-09). The hoods are hand-modelled by the builder; the chequer bands and barred basement windows are not.

walls[6] (panel 19, surfaces 38 and 121): the Marnixstraat end block (panorama 2020-08-31, 2024-12-16): brick with a ribbon of two-light windows on the middle floors and a glazed ground floor with a stair and a flat canopy on one post. 3DBAG gives it a plain flat top; the curved glazed top storey with its overhanging roof is not modelled.
Walls of groups [1], [3]-[5], [9], [12]-[14] are inferred from the eaves height and the neighbouring walls: no panorama reaches them; windows follow the default bay pitch.

walls[7] and walls[14] stand on raised ground in 3DBAG (16.9 m and 8.6 m): the fit counts storeys from the 3DBAG ground, so windows start at the first storey line above the raised ground. Surfaces with a sliver width (3DBAG strips under 0.5 m) are left out of the groups: they break the block kit's attachment gate.
